title: Merge queue red on every group since #37366: four content/docs CLI transcripts still print "author-time rules (83)"; the registry now derives 85
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect in a required gate that ejects every merge-queue group. Source: triage probe, R1430.

## 维护者速读

- 合并队列从 07:42 起每一批都失败，所有排队的 PR 都进不了主干。原因是 #37366（你用管理员权限合并的改名 PR）新增了两条检查规则，规则总数从 83 变成 85，但有四篇文档里的命令输出示例还写着 83，文档一致性检查因此不通过。
- 修法是把这四处的 83 改成 85，属于很小的改动；修好之前，next.1 的版本 PR 也不能合并。

## Reading

- Merge-queue runs of `Lint & Type Check` failed on these PR groups from 07:42Z, 2026-11-27: #37837, #37751, #37840, #37841, #37846, #37668 and #37859 (runs 45960367280 … 45961655469). Each fails at job "Type Check · workspace", gate `cli-transcripts-in-content-docs-match` (`check-docs-transcript-drift`), with the same 4 findings:
  - `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:940`
  - `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx:872`
  - `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx:321`
  - `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx:407`

  Each prints `author-time rules (83)`; `authoringRulesFor('build' | 'validate')` derives **85** today.
- Cause: `adb65d1615` (PR #37366, merged 07:14Z with administrator rights, so it skipped the merge queue) adds two rules to `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (+32 lines). The transcripts were not regenerated. Every queue group built on `main` since then is red, deterministically. It is not a flake.
- Re-check: `node scripts/check-docs-transcript-drift.mjs` (or the lint lane's gate) on `origin/main`.

## Fix

Update the four transcript lines to `author-time rules (85)`. Prefer the transcripts' own regeneration path if the gate offers one. One docs-only PR, no changeset.

## Grade

p0 while the merge queue is stalled for every PR. The next.1 Version PR (#37661, refreshed 07:21Z) also carries this tree. Triage returns the grade to p1 when this card closes.
